observations.why: Imperative command directed at a subordinate's knowledge state — hierarchy enacted through a directive to purge information.
Command to eliminate retained knowledge — authority-ranking enacted through an explicit deletion directive with no negotiation.
Assertive that ratifies the deletion directive by rewriting institutional history — authority-ranking performed as factual override, not request.

mints.name: DirectiveMemoryPurge
mints.title: Remove all knowledge
mints.frame: Is authority here enacted as a command to eliminate what is known, rather than to act or decide?
